subject: DI03005021

body.en:
Definition and principle

Fluidization occurs when an upward fluid flow supports a bed of particles so that the bed acquires fluid-like mobility. A fixed packed bed becomes incipiently fluidized when fluid drag supports its effective immersed weight. Superficial velocity uses the empty vessel cross-section, not the remaining pore area.

Important points

Liquid–solid beds often expand relatively uniformly; gas–solid beds can bubble or become turbulent/entraining, depending on particles and conditions. Uses include fluidized catalytic reactors, combustion, drying, coating and heat exchange. Good mixing/high transfer rates are advantages; attrition, entrainment, erosion and bypassing are limitations. Fluidization does not mean all particles are individually at their isolated terminal velocity.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Upward fluid flow particles ના bed ને support કરતાં bed માં fluid જેવી mobility આવે તેને Fluidization કહે છે.Fluid drag effective immersed weight ને support કરે ત્યારે fixed packed bed incipiently fluidized બને છે.Superficial Velocity માટે empty vessel cross-section લેવાય છે, pore area નહીં.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Liquid–solid beds ઘણીવાર relatively uniform expand થાય છે.Gas–solid beds માં particles/conditions પ્રમાણે bubbling, turbulence અથવા entrainment થાય છે.Fluidized catalytic reactors, combustion, drying, coating તથા heat exchange માં ઉપયોગ છે.સારી mixing તથા ઊંચા transfer rates લાભ છે.Attrition, entrainment, erosion તથા bypassing મર્યાદાઓ છે.Fluidization એટલે દરેક particle isolated terminal velocity પર છે એવું નથી.

title.gu: Drag,Drag Coefficient તથા Stokes નો નિયમ

h.gu: Drag,Drag Coefficient તથા Stokes નો નિયમ

body.en:
Definition and principle

Drag is the fluid force opposing relative motion of a body. CD is defined using fluid density, relative speed and a specified projected area. For a sphere the projected area is πdp²/4.Stokes’ law gives drag on an isolated rigid sphere in creeping Newtonian flow; particle Reynolds number must be much smaller than unity.

Important points

The particle drag coefficient CD is not a meter discharge coefficient Cd. At higher particle Re, use a suitable drag correlation rather than Stokes’ law. Wall confinement, non-spherical shape, neighbouring particles and non-Newtonian behaviour change drag. Terminal settling/rising occurs when the net body force balances drag; minimum fluidization of an entire packed bed is a different condition.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Body તથા fluid ની relative motion નો વિરોધ કરતું fluid force Drag છે.CD માટે fluid density, relative speed તથા specified projected area વપરાય છે.Sphere માટે projected area πdp²/4 છે.Stokes law isolated rigid sphere માટે creeping Newtonian flow માં લાગુ પડે છે.Particle Reynolds Number એક કરતાં ઘણો ઓછો હોવો જોઈએ.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Particle Drag Coefficient CD તથા Meter Discharge Coefficient Cd જુદા છે.ઊંચા particle Re પર Stokes law ના બદલે યોગ્ય drag correlation લો.Wall confinement, non-spherical shape, neighbouring particles તથા non-Newtonian behaviour થી drag બદલાય છે.Net body force અને drag balance થાય ત્યારે terminal settling/rising મળે છે.Whole packed bed નું minimum fluidization અલગ condition છે.

body.en:
Definition and principle

Minimum fluidization velocity Umf is the superficial velocity at the onset of bed support/expansion under specified conditions. The pressure force across the particles then balances bed weight minus buoyancy. Subtract distributor/empty-apparatus loss from the measured total when identifying particle-bed pressure drop.

Important points

In a fixed bed, pressure drop rises with velocity. Near onset it reaches the effective bed-weight-per-area level; with a retained solids inventory, it is approximately level as the bed expands. Umf depends on particle size/shape, densities, viscosity and voidage at onset. It is not generally equal to a single particle’s terminal velocity. Channeling, cohesion or distributor maldistribution can prevent the ideal behaviour. The Ergun-based relation below assumes an appropriate packed-bed model and spherical particles.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા અને સિદ્ધાંત

Specified conditions માં bed support/expansion શરૂ થાય તે Superficial Velocity ને Umf કહે છે.Particles પરનો pressure force bed weight minus buoyancy ને balance કરે છે.Particle-bed pressure drop કાઢવા measured total માંથી distributor/empty-apparatus loss ઘટાડવો જરૂરી છે.

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

Fixed bed માં velocity સાથે pressure drop વધે છે.Onset નજીક તે effective bed-weight-per-area જેટલું થાય છે.Retained solids inventory હોય તો expansion દરમિયાન આશરે plateau રહે છે.Umf particle size/shape, densities, viscosity તથા onset voidage પર આધારિત છે.તે single-particle terminal velocity જેટલું હોવું જરૂરી નથી.Channeling, cohesion અથવા distributor maldistribution થી ideal behaviour ન મળે.નીચેના Ergun આધારિત સંબંધ માટે યોગ્ય packed-bed model તથા spherical particles ની assumptions છે.
